DeployBot: ALERT: us-west-2 embeddings-route p95 spike 2.3x over baseline in 3m. Auto-rollback blocked by pin. https://dash.redwood/alerts/6923 :rotating_light:
Taylor: I see the spike. Any related deploys in the last 10m?
Lee: manifest push ~6m ago. Proxy shows elevated 5xx and KV miss.
Taylor: since pin blocks auto-rollback, prefer unpin + staged reroute instead of full rollback (migration flags involved). OpsLead?
OpsLead: agree. Emergency unpin runbook: pause releases, unpin staged 15%, observe 10m. Rollback only if p95 > 2x baseline OR 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m. Annotate release notes.
CSLead: I'll draft customer notice for impacted accounts, stand by.
Taylor: running: `deployctl unpin --route=embeds-main --staged=15 --until=2026-03-23T16:00Z`
DeployBot: Action: unpin started, staged slice 15% -> https://deploy.redwood/actions/692345
EngOncall: telemetry: at 15% slice p95 trending down to 1.15x baseline after 2m. 5xxs dropping. Monitoring 10m.
OpsLead: If stable, ramp 15% -> 40% -> 80% in 5m intervals. Lock change window for 45m. No merges to embeddings until cleared.
CSLead: Draft message: "Transient latency increase affecting embeddings in us-west-2. We staged traffic to a stable variant; metrics improving. Will update in 30m."
Taylor: posting updates to #eng-oncall and starting postmortem stub: https://docs.redwood/incident/692345-unpin. Thanks all :thumbsup:
